inlines.v: BRAZIL' BRAZIL'-WOOD, noun brazil or brazil-wood, or braziletto, is a very heavy wood of a red color, growing in brazil and other tropical countries. It is used in manufactures for dyeing red. It is a species of Caesalpina.
